company.notes: Visa Inc. is a Delaware corporation that consummated its restructuring (combining Visa U.S.A., Visa International, Visa Canada and Inovant) during October 1-3, 2007, when its first full 18-member board was seated. Its class A common stock began trading on the NYSE under 'V' on March 19, 2008 (IPO). Fiscal year ends September 30; annual meetings are held in late January. The board was classified at the 2007 restructuring and is now declassified (one-year terms). Leadership: independent Chair Matschullat (2013-04-01 to 2019-04-16), then Chair and CEO Kelly with Lead Independent Director Lundgren, then Executive Chairman Kelly (2023-02-01 to 2024-01-23), and since 2024-01-23 independent Chair Lundgren.

conflicts.description: Suzanne Nora Johnson has two SEC reporting-owner CIKs. Her 2008 Visa Form 3 was filed under CIK 0001427505 ('Johnson Suzanne Nora'), but her 2021-2022 Visa Forms 4 use CIK 0001310264 ('NORA JOHNSON SUZANNE M'), the same CIK as in the NVIDIA seed. Kept 0001310264 as sec_cik so she matches across companies; the older name form is kept as an alias.

Exact day the 2007 directors were seated. The 8-K says the board was increased to 18 'immediately prior to the closing of the restructuring on October 1, 2007', but the same 8-K says the restructuring was consummated over October 1-3, 2007, and the prospectus and proxies give only 'October 2007'. Kept 2007-10-01 for Fernández-Carbajal, Cranston, Matschullat, Nora Johnson and Swainson.

Board-size gaps before 2019. The 2015 8-K takes the board from 11 to 12 for Carney, but the 2017 and 2018 8-Ks each start from nine. The pre-2019 departures behind the drop (e.g., Charles Scharf's resignation effective 2016-12-01 and Gary Hoffman's 2018-03-29 resignation) are out of scope and not recorded, so only disclosed size changes appear as events.

open_questions: Committee assignments after the 2026-01-27 annual meeting are not disclosed. Laguarta's seats on the Finance and Nominating committees ended with his departure, and no filing through 2026-10-02 reports any reassignment. The next proxy (expected December 2026) should settle this.

When Al Kelly stopped being independent is not stated. His independent span ends, and his non-independent span starts, on 2016-10-31, the day he became an employee as CEO Designate (CEO from 2016-12-01). Both are medium confidence.
Swainson's Lead Director start is month precision ('since October 2007'); no filing gives a day.
The year the board was declassified was not researched. It was classified (Classes I-III) at the 2007 restructuring; every director now stands for annual election.
Pre-2020 departures (e.g., Gary Coughlan in 2014, Charles Scharf in 2016, Gary Hoffman in 2018, and the 2007-era regional directors) are out of scope and not recorded.
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations only (appointment 8-Ks and each proxy).
Other-board lists come from Visa's own bios as of each director's latest Visa proxy and are not checked against other issuers' filings. For departed directors the status is as of that older proxy.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2025-12-08), the 2026-01-27 Item 5.07 results (all 11 nominees elected), and every 8-K filed after the proxy through 2026-10-02 (none has Item 5.02; the 5.03 and 8.01 filings read). All ten non-employee directors filed 2026-01-27 Forms 4 as directors and McInerney filed Forms 4 as director and CEO through 2026-10-01. Board size of 11 reconciles with every disclosed change.

Every DEF 14A from 2019-12 to 2025-12 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed. Annual-meeting slates compared year over year, and board size reconciled across each join and departure (11 on 2020-01-01; 11 now). Departures dated from the Item 5.07 meeting date (all six did not stand).

Pre-2020 seats only for directors serving in 2020 or later, reconstructed from the October 2007 restructuring 8-K, the IPO prospectus, appointment 8-Ks, Forms 3 and proxies. Other pre-2020 directors are not recorded.
